gloss: to stand out from the crowd; to be outstanding

definitions.gloss: to stand out from the crowd; to be outstanding; to be head and shoulders above
definitions.explanation: To be exceptionally superior compared to others in a group. Literally means "to pull out from the herd/group." Used as high praise for someone or something far exceeding the norm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いておいしい。
examples.english: This shop's ramen is far and away the most delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プレゼンテーション→プレゼンテーション：29053_purezenteeshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Among the many applicants, his presentation was head and shoulders above the rest.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the て-form as {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて (outstandingly, far and above) or the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧-form {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is outstanding). Often modifies adjectives: {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (outstandingly high), {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧ (exceptionally excellent).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いた + noun ({群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いた⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧, outstanding talent)
- {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて + adjective ({群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧, outstandingly beautiful)
- {群|ぐん}を{抜|ぬ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is outstanding)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧: Outstanding, preeminent — a na-adjective derived from the same concept. More compact and commonly used as a modifier: ⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧ (outstanding grades).
- ⟦{際立|きわだ}つ→際立つ：07832_kiwadatsu⟧: To stand out — emphasizes being conspicuously different, not necessarily superior.
